_doc: Routes between Home and Work (Home/Work themselves live in places.json). 'via' = [lon, lat] waypoints forcing TomTom through a route, either one list (Home->Work order, reversed for Work->Home) or {to_work: [...], to_home: [...]} when a motorway waypoint must sit on the carriageway of that direction (OSM PR milestones; the wrong side makes TomTom U-turn). 'markers' report which places a computed route passes.
